title: Plan Credit in the Named Non-Owner Policy Package-Change Increase Charge
content:
In the increase charge for a mid-term Named Non-Owner Policy package change, the billing plan of the term sets a credit.

| Billing plan of the term (Installment Payment Plans) | Plan credit |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | 0.94 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan | 0.97 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 0.97 |
| Two-Pay, Four-Pay, Six-Pay Direct Bill or any other plan | none |

The credit multiplies the increase rated premium before the deduction is subtracted, and before the charge is rounded to the cent; every other plan carries no such credit.
